standard: 音译专名统一 + 自然意译；一句一译；键取自对齐原串（Think 1 11-18/11-19 已验收译文）

entries.en: These days, we use credit cards more and more and they all look almost identical.
entries.zh: 如今，我们使用信用卡越来越多，而且它们看起来几乎都一样。

entries.en: But money is still with us, in coins and banknotes.
entries.zh: 但货币仍然存在于我们的生活中，有硬币，也有纸币。

entries.en: The designs are different and all over the world we can see examples of really interesting and beautiful banknotes.
entries.zh: 各地的图案各不相同，在世界各地我们都能看到非常有趣、非常漂亮的纸币。

entries.en: The designs usually celebrate the country – its history, its geography, its animals and birds.
entries.zh: 图案通常是为了颂扬一个国家——它的历史、地理、动物和鸟类。

entries.en: Here are some examples of banknotes from different parts of the world.
entries.zh: 下面介绍几种来自世界各地的纸币。

entries.en: Mexico
entries.zh: 墨西哥

entries.en: In Mexico the currency is the peso.
entries.zh: 在墨西哥，货币是比索。

entries.en: The smallest banknote is 20 pesos, and the biggest is 1,000 pesos.
entries.zh: 最小的纸币是 20 比索，最大的是 1,000 比索。

entries.en: One side always has the face of a famous person from Mexican history and the other side has well-known places in the country.
entries.zh: 纸币的一面总是印着墨西哥历史上一位名人的头像，另一面是该国著名的景点。

entries.en: On the $500 note there is a portrait of the famous Mexican artist Frida Kahlo.
entries.zh: 在 500 比索纸币上，印着著名墨西哥画家弗里达·卡罗的肖像。

entries.en: Europe
entries.zh: 欧洲

entries.en: Many countries in Europe use the euro, but the banknotes are exactly the same for each country.
entries.zh: 欧洲许多国家使用欧元，但各国的纸币完全一样。

entries.en: On one side, there is a picture of a gate, window or entrance, and on the other side, a bridge.
entries.zh: 一面画着门、窗户或入口，另一面是一座桥。

entries.en: The pictures represent different kinds of architecture from all over Europe.
entries.zh: 这些图案代表了来自欧洲各地不同种类的建筑。

entries.en: Turkey
entries.zh: 土耳其

entries.en: In Turkey the currency is the Turkish lira, and there are six different banknotes.
entries.zh: 在土耳其，货币是土耳其里拉，一共有 6 种不同的纸币。

entries.en: Each one shows Kemal Atatürk, the founder of the Turkish republic, on the front side, and another famous figure from Turkish history on the other side.
entries.zh: 每张纸币正面都印着土耳其共和国的创立者凯末尔·阿塔图尔克，另一面是土耳其历史上的另一位名人。

entries.en: Brazil
entries.zh: 巴西

entries.en: The currency in Brazil is the real (plural, reais).
entries.zh: 巴西的货币是雷亚尔（复数是 reais）。

entries.en: The notes are in different colours, but they all have a picture of the Effigy of the Republic (a national symbol of Brazil) on one side, and various animals, birds and fish on the other side.
entries.zh: 纸币颜色各不相同，但都印着巴西的国家象征——共和国女神像——另一面则是各种动物、鸟类和鱼类。

entries.en: One of the most beautiful is perhaps the R$50 note, which has a picture of a jaguar.
entries.zh: 其中最漂亮的也许是 50 雷亚尔纸币，上面印着一只美洲豹。
